findings.current: Even without arms, it was more than dangerous enough bare-handed.
findings.defect: Calling an armless creature “bare-handed” is contradictory. The source says its body alone remains dangerous.
findings.rationale: 맨몸으로 means relying on its bare body, not fighting with bare hands.
findings.replacement: Even without arms, its body alone was still more than dangerous enough.
findings.source: 양팔을 잃었지만 놈은 맨몸으로도 충분히 위협적인 존재니까.

findings.current: Every step it gave, a new wound opened and more blood spilled.
findings.defect: “Every step it gave” is unidiomatic and obscures that the monster is retreating step by step.
findings.rationale: 물러날 때마다 explicitly means each time it stepped back.
findings.replacement: With every step it retreated, a new wound opened and more blood spilled.
findings.source: 한 걸음씩 물러날 때마다, 새로운 상처가 생기고 더 많은 피가 쏟아졌다.

findings.current: An awl in a bag pokes through.
findings.defect: The established rendering of the idiom is not used.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 낭중지추 as “needle in a bag,” describing exceptional talent that inevitably reveals itself.
findings.replacement: A needle in a bag eventually pokes through.

findings.current: Well, I’m not some prestigious family’s son here. And I’m sure as hell no Sleeping Dragon.
findings.defect: The established rendering of 잠룡 is replaced with a different epithet.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 잠룡 as “Hidden Dragon.”
findings.replacement: Well, I’m not some prestigious family’s son here. And I’m sure as hell no Hidden Dragon.
findings.source: 하긴, 나는 여기서 명문가 자제도 아니고, 잠룡 같은 건 더더욱 아니니까.

findings.current: Food in Murim was spicy, salty, and bland. And even then, more days than not, I couldn’t eat properly. For thirty days, my stomach had been abused with beef jerky, bigu pills,[^1] and rice balls.
findings.defect: The established English term for 벽곡단 is replaced by a romanization requiring an unnecessary footnote.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 벽곡단 as “fasting pills.”
findings.replacement: Food in Murim was spicy, salty, and bland. And even then, more days than not, I couldn’t eat properly. For thirty days, my stomach had been abused with beef jerky, fasting pills, and rice balls.
findings.source: 무림의 음식은 맵고 짜고 싱겁다. 그마저도 제대로 못 먹는 날이 더 많았다. 30일간 내 위장은 육포와 벽곡단, 주먹밥으로 혹사당했다.

findings.current: “—You bastard, you’re a ghost. I was just about to call you.”
findings.defect: The literal “you’re a ghost” is unnatural in English and loses the caller’s remark about Choi’s uncannily perfect timing.
findings.rationale: Here 귀신이네 is an idiomatic reaction to Choi calling at exactly the right moment, not a claim that he is literally a ghost.
findings.replacement: “—You bastard, are you psychic or what? I was just about to call you.”
findings.source: 이 자식, 귀신이네. 안 그래도 연락하려고 했는데.

findings.current: My martial arts, my stats, and even my steel-like Sinews and Bones had come with it.
findings.defect: The established System attribute terminology is not used.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 근골 as “Muscles and Bones.”
findings.replacement: My martial arts, my stats, and even my steel-like Muscles and Bones had come with it.
findings.source: 무공과 능력치. 그리고 강철 같은 근골까지 포함이다.

findings.defect: Team Leader Choi’s established contact display name is replaced with a different rendering.
findings.rationale: The block glossary explicitly establishes 명품충 as the display name “Designer-Brand Junkie.”

findings.current: Jinho hyung stared blankly, looking from me to the phone in my hand.
findings.defect: The phone is assigned to Taekyung’s hand, but the source says Jinho is holding it.
findings.rationale: 손에 쥔 핸드폰 refers to the phone Jinho has just been given and is currently holding.
findings.replacement: Jinho hyung stared blankly, looking from me to the phone in his hand.
findings.source: 진호 형이 멍한 얼굴로 나와 손에 쥔 핸드폰을 번갈아 봤다.

findings.defect: The established form of address is replaced with a different rank.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 조장, Hyuk Mujin’s address for Taekyung, as “Captain.”

findings.current: “Why is the squad leader suddenly like this now of all times…”
findings.defect: The repeated established form of address is again replaced with a different rank.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 조장 as “Captain,” and the dream voice is referring to Taekyung by that title.
findings.replacement: “Why is Captain suddenly like this now of all times…”

summary: The block is broadly faithful, but contains one contradictory combat description, several established-term mismatches, and a handful of localized idiomatic or physical-detail errors.
